detail: Three modes, each timed on a monotonic clock and reproducible from a seed: running count through a real shoe, true-count conversion, and reading the discard tray. The tray is now drawn and estimated by eye, and the cards deal at a settable speed.
doneWhen: Tray estimation from a photograph, which is a different problem: it needs real trays shot at real angles. Cards that disappear after a set time are deliberately not coming, because that makes the drill a recall test and breaks the clock.
title: Counting drills
